Model.description: A Model registered on an Azure Arc-enabled Kubernetes cluster. Models are reusable artifacts that one or more ModelDeployments can reference.

properties.description: The resource-specific properties for this resource.

extendedLocation.description: The Arc-enabled cluster extended location where this resource runs. Required; immutable after create.

ModelByCatalog.description: Reference to a model from the Foundry Local catalog. The cluster resolves the catalog entry against its installed catalog ConfigMap.

ModelByCustom.description: Inline reference to a custom model. Equivalent to creating a Microsoft.FoundryLocal/models resource and referencing it, but provides a one-shot path for deployments that do not need a reusable Model.

ModelByMaas.description: Reference to an external Models-as-a-Service (MaaS) deployment. Inference traffic is forwarded to the upstream MaaS endpoint via a thin CPU-only router pod on the cluster. Requires `runtime` to be `Maas` and `compute` to be `Cpu`.

backendRef.description: Name of the MaaS backend (configured on the cluster's helm values) to route through. Immutable after create.

maasDeploymentName.description: Name of the deployment in the upstream MaaS control plane. Immutable after create.

sku.description: SKU for the MaaS deployment. `name` is immutable after create; `capacity` is mutable.

ModelByRef.description: Reference to an existing Microsoft.FoundryLocal/models resource. The referenced Model must be on the same Arc cluster (same `extendedLocation`) as the deployment.

modelId.description: ARM resource ID of the Microsoft.FoundryLocal/models resource to reference.

contextLength.description: Maximum context window size supported by the model.

streaming.description: Whether the model supports streaming responses. Cluster default is false if omitted.

ModelCondition.description: Detailed status condition reported for a Model.

reason.description: Machine-readable reason for the condition's last transition.

lastTransitionTime.description: Timestamp of the last transition for this condition.

ModelConditionType.description: Standard Kubernetes-style condition type for a Model.

values.name: Available
values.description: Whether the model is currently available for use by deployments.

ModelDeployment.description: A model deployment running on an Azure Arc-enabled Kubernetes cluster.

properties.description: The resource-specific properties for this resource.

extendedLocation.description: The Arc-enabled cluster extended location where this resource runs. Required; immutable after create.

ModelDeploymentCondition.description: Detailed status condition reported for a model deployment.

reason.description: Machine-readable reason for the condition's last transition.

lastTransitionTime.description: Timestamp of the last transition for this condition.

observedGeneration.description: The value of metadata.generation the condition was set for.

values.name: True
values.description: The condition is currently true.

values.name: False
values.description: The condition is currently false.

values.name: Unknown
values.description: The current condition status is unknown.

ModelDeploymentConditionType.description: Standard Kubernetes-style condition type for a model deployment.

values.name: Available
values.description: Whether the deployment is currently available and serving traffic.

values.name: Progressing
values.description: Whether the deployment is currently being rolled out.

values.name: Degraded
values.description: Whether the deployment is in a degraded state.

value.description: The ModelDeployment items on this page

nextLink.description: The link to the next page of items

ModelDeploymentPhase.description: Observed lifecycle phase of a model deployment on the cluster.

values.name: Pending
values.description: The deployment has been accepted by the cluster but not yet scheduled.

values.name: Creating
values.description: The deployment is being created on the cluster.

values.name: Running
values.description: The deployment is in the operational phase. Detailed readiness is reported via conditions.

values.name: Updating
values.description: The deployment is being updated.

values.name: Error
values.description: The deployment has encountered an error.

values.name: Terminating
values.description: The deployment is being terminated.

ModelDeploymentProperties.description: Properties of a ModelDeployment resource. Cross-field constraints (e.g. `Predictive` requires a Custom model; `Vllm` runtime requires GPU compute; `Maas` model requires `Maas` runtime and CPU compute) are enforced by the cluster on PUT and surface as 400 errors if violated.

provisioningState.description: The provisioning state of the resource.

model.description: Reference to the model this deployment serves. Immutable after create.

compute.description: Compute type for the deployment. Immutable after create.

workloadType.description: Type of inference workload. Defaults to `Generative`. `Predictive` requires a Custom model. Immutable after create.

values.name: Generative
values.description: Generative (LLM) workload.

values.name: Predictive
values.description: Predictive (classification/regression) workload. Requires a custom model.

runtime.description: Inference runtime engine. Defaults to `OnnxGenai`. Must be `Maas` if and only if the model is `Maas`. `Vllm` requires `Gpu` compute. Immutable after create.

values.name: OnnxGenai
values.description: ONNX Runtime GenAI engine.

values.name: Vllm
values.description: vLLM engine. Requires GPU compute.

values.name: Maas
values.description: Models-as-a-Service router. Forwards inference requests to an external MaaS endpoint. Required when using the Maas model variant.

displayName.description: Human-readable deployment name shown in tooling.

replicas.description: Number of pod replicas to run. Defaults to 1.

port.description: Container port the inference server listens on. Defaults to 5000.

skipGpuResource.description: When true, allows `Gpu` compute without requiring the `nvidia.com/gpu` resource limit. Must be used with `nodeSelector` to target GPU nodes manually.

vllmConfig.description: vLLM-specific runtime configuration. Used only when `runtime` is `Vllm`.

resources.description: Resource requirements for the inference container.

env.description: Environment variables to set on the inference container.

tolerations.description: Tolerations that allow inference pods to be scheduled on tainted nodes.

nodeSelector.description: Kubernetes node selector labels for pod scheduling. Keys are user-defined cluster node labels.

endpoint.description: External endpoint (Ingress) configuration for the deployment.

status.description: Observed status of the model deployment as reported by the cluster.

ModelDeploymentStatus.description: Observed status of a model deployment as reported by the cluster.

phase.description: Current lifecycle phase of the deployment on the cluster.

endpointUrl.description: Inference endpoint URL exposed by the deployment, once ready.

readyReplicas.description: Number of replicas currently in the Ready condition.

conditions.description: Latest condition states reported by the cluster.

resolvedModel.description: Information about the model variant the cluster resolved and deployed for this request.

lastObservedAt.description: Timestamp when the cluster last refreshed this status block.

ResolvedModel.description: Identifies the specific model variant the cluster resolved and deployed.

name.description: Resolved model identifier (catalog name) on the cluster.

variant.description: Selected variant identifier within the model (e.g., 'cpu-fp16', 'gpu-int8').

image.description: Container image deployed by the cluster.

ResourceLimits.description: Maximum resource limits for the inference container.

cpu.description: CPU limit. Cluster default is '4000m' if omitted.

memory.description: Memory limit. Cluster default is '1Gi' if omitted.

ResourceRequests.description: Minimum resource requests for the inference container.

cpu.description: CPU request, e.g. '100m', '0.5', '2'. Cluster default is '2000m' if omitted.

memory.description: Memory request, e.g. '256Mi', '1Gi'. Cluster default is '256Mi' if omitted.

ResourceRequirements.description: Resource requirements for the inference container.

RuntimeType.description: Inference runtime engine that serves the model.

values.name: OnnxGenai
values.description: ONNX Runtime GenAI engine.

values.name: Vllm
values.description: vLLM engine. Requires GPU compute.

values.name: Maas
values.description: Models-as-a-Service router. Forwards inference requests to an external MaaS endpoint. Required when using the Maas model variant.

SecretReference.description: Reference to a Kubernetes Secret holding registry credentials. The secret must exist in either the target deployment namespace or the operator's release namespaces.

usernameKey.description: Key in the secret that holds the username. Defaults to 'username' if omitted.

passwordKey.description: Key in the secret that holds the password. Defaults to 'password' if omitted.

enabled.description: Whether TLS is enabled on the endpoint. Cluster default is false if omitted. When true, `endpoint.host` and `secretName` are required.

secretName.description: Name of the Kubernetes TLS secret to use. Required when TLS is enabled.

Toleration.description: Kubernetes node taint toleration that allows the inference pods to be scheduled on tainted nodes.

operator.description: Operator. 'Equal' matches by key+value; 'Exists' matches by key only.

tolerationSeconds.description: Duration in seconds to tolerate the taint. Only valid for 'NoExecute' effect.

TolerationEffect.description: Effect of a Kubernetes node taint to tolerate.

values.name: NoSchedule
values.description: Pods will not be scheduled onto tainted nodes unless they tolerate the taint.

values.name: PreferNoSchedule
values.description: Scheduler will avoid placing pods on tainted nodes but will not strictly forbid it.

values.name: NoExecute
values.description: Running pods that do not tolerate the taint will be evicted.

TolerationOperator.description: Operator for a Kubernetes node taint toleration.

values.name: Equal
values.description: Toleration value must equal the taint value.

values.name: Exists
values.description: Toleration matches any value (or the absence of a value).

VllmConfig.description: vLLM-specific runtime configuration. Relevant only when `runtime` is `Vllm`.

modelCacheStorageGi.description: Size of the model weight cache PVC in GiB. Cluster default is 100 if omitted.

epp.description: EPP (Endpoint Picker) configuration for inference-aware load balancing.

preferences.description: vLLM engine preferences passed through to the runtime, e.g. `max_model_len`, `gpu_memory_utilization`. Keys and accepted values depend on the vLLM version installed on the cluster.

WorkloadType.description: Type of inference workload served by a model deployment.

values.description: Generative (LLM) workload.

values.name: Predictive
values.description: Predictive (classification/regression) workload. Requires a custom model.
